lines.zh: 爪子落地,几乎没有声音
lines.en: My claws touch down almost silently.
I walk along the fence's shadow.
My tail feathers steady each turn.
My sickle claw is folded up.
I slip low through the ferns.
I stop at every step to listen.
My pack keeps pace behind me.
I skirt the puddle without splashing.

lines.zh: 围栏的每道缝我都钻过。
lines.en: I've slipped through every gap in the fence.
I circle the paddock once.
Light feet, restless eyes.
I follow the scent forward.
Grass brushes past my ribs.

lines.zh: 我换了个角度接近目标
lines.en: I shift my angle on the target.
I stand still, but not relaxed.
Head tilted, I listen far off.
I lick the tip of my claw.
A low trill hums in my throat.
I am counting how many of you there are.
My tail sweeps the ground slowly.
I stare at the gap in the fence.

lines.zh: 不动的时候更难被发现
lines.en: Standing still makes me harder to spot.
I narrow my eyes to slits.
I wait for my pack's signal.
This place smells unfamiliar.
My breathing is shallow and steady.
The stripes on my neck shift.
Patience: a raptor never lacks it.
Stand still and let me look at you.
You smell of iron.
I lift my head and look straight at you.
You are a little shorter than the fence.
My head tilt is me measuring distance.
Your eyes blink faster than before.
There's warmth where you stood.
Your hand moves; I saw it.
I creep half a step, then stop.
You are deciding whether to turn.

lines.zh: 我对着你发出一声短鸣
lines.en: I give you one short chirp.
My pack is watching you too.
Hss, you touched me.
That one stung.
I dodge late by half a step.
Do not think I will retreat.
My flank is burning.
You hit harder than you look.
I growl and shift my stance.
Not deep; I can still stand.
I will return that one.
My pack is watching; I cannot fall.
That is meat; I can tell.
Hold it a little higher.
I stretch my neck forward.
That smell makes my claws itch.
I circle to your downwind side.
That is my favourite bite.
My hiss turns softer.
Do not let your hand shake; I am close.
For that, I can wait.

lines.zh: 我盯着那块肉,不看别处
lines.en: I fix on the meat and nothing else.
You charge; I turn aside and shed it.
Shoulder to shoulder, and you give ground.
Do not stand in my path.
I am shoved one step off balance.
I growl once, as a warning.
I will remember this shove.
I use your push to pivot.
Your armour scraped me.
Step back and try that again.
You've ruffled my tail feathers.
I lean my head against yours.
We groom each other's neck feathers.
This call only you understand.
Our nest lies deep in the ferns.
Follow me; do not fall behind.
Side by side, our steps fall in time.
I keep watch; you rest first.
We shared the same piece of meat.
Our tails touch, lightly.
This hunting ground is ours.
This shiny thing: mine.
I snatch it up and run.
I hide it under the fern leaves.
It is a little hard to bite.
One more for my collection.
This goes to my nest.
I hook it closer with a claw.
Do not grab it; I saw it first.
Heavy. Useful.
I hold it and look up at you.
I have you locked.
The feathers on my neck stand up.
You retreat slower than I thought.
I found your opening.
The prey's breathing has gone uneven.
This is the moment; go.

lines.zh: 我压低了身体,准备起跳
lines.en: I drop low, ready to spring.
You are the pack's target now.
Direction set; no turning back.
My pupils narrow to a line.
This hunt starts with you.
I count to three in my head.
My pack fans out to flank you.
Do not run; it will not help.
I track your silhouette.
You go left; I am already there.
I tighten the ring, little by little.
Each step you retreat, I take one.
I stay silent; noise would spook you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子一次就划开三道。
lines.en: My claws leave three lines at once.
This blood trail is fresh.
You hide behind the tree; I see you.
We have you on three sides.
One more step back and you are at the water.
I wait for the instant you turn.
Close enough now; nearer would spook you.
I am sharpening my claws.
Breath slows; I ready the burst.
What you cannot hear, I can.
The sickle claw arrives first.
I leap in from the side.
My teeth sink into your shoulder.
My momentum takes you off your feet.
This claw tears through cloth armour.
Do not try to follow me with your eyes alone.
I pin you down, then bite.
Blood spatters my snout.
I shake my head and tear a piece free.
The second claw follows.
My packmate strikes from behind me.
I land lightly; you fall.
This is my rhythm.
I aimed for the throat.
I crunch the leaves and raise my head.
One of the four has arrived.

lines.zh: 我从围栏的暗处走出来
lines.en: I step out of the paddock's dark corner.
My claws emerge from the grass first.
A short cry cuts the woods.
I remember this place, and you.
The wind carries my scent out.
My pack is on its way.
I shake the dirt off my back.
My eyes brighten first.
That shadow is no branch.
I quietly take my place behind you.
The woods go quiet for a moment.

lines.zh: 这片林子的猎手回来了
lines.en: The hunter of these woods is back.
I am breathing. Do you hear it?
My claw marks stay in the mud.
I crouch low, waiting to be noticed.
Variant blood was never tame.
My feathers scorch; the smell is foul.
My legs hit first and go numb.
Water floods my throat; I thrash.
The blast throws me into the ferns.
An arrow is stuck in my hind leg.
That force makes my legs unsteady.
Hunger makes my claws tremble.
Lightning runs through me; my sight goes white.
No ground beneath me; I cannot grip.
